not_observable.case: tests/integration/test_tracker_repositories.py::test_resolves_the_repository_whose_remote_matches: the resolver matches normalized remote URLs, and the runner has no git step that adds a remote, so no repository can carry a remote; the match is reached only through a tracker sync, which needs a fake Jira
tests/integration/test_tracker_repositories.py::test_match_is_case_insensitive: remote matching on a mixed-case URL needs a repository remote the runner cannot create

tests/integration/test_tracker_repositories.py::test_unknown_repository_resolves_to_none: the None result is observed only through a sync's task-to-repository link, which needs a fake Jira and a remote the runner cannot add

tests/integration/test_tracker_repositories.py::test_archived_repository_is_not_resolved: the resolver filters archived repositories by remote match, and the remote cannot be set up; the archive state itself is covered by this scenario through repo remove, repo list --all and repo show

tests/integration/test_tracker_repositories.py::test_archived_match_does_not_hide_an_active_one: two repositories sharing one remote need remotes the runner cannot add, and resolution is reached only through a sync

tests/integration/test_tracker_repositories.py::test_ambiguous_match_resolves_to_none: two active repositories with the same remote need remotes the runner cannot add, and the ambiguity is observable only through a sync
tests/integration/test_tracker_repositories.py::test_one_repository_with_two_matching_remotes_is_not_ambiguous: two remotes on one repository need a git remote step the runner does not have

tests/integration/test_tracker_repositories.py::test_other_workspaces_are_not_searched: a second workspace plus a remote-matched repository needs remotes the runner cannot add, and resolution is reached only through a sync
